note.p: The second wife of James Mackintosh, and sister-in-law of Josiah Wedgwood. Catherine Allen, one of Launcelot Baugh Allen's sisters. Two of Baugh Allen's sisters married into the Wedgewood family. Jenny Allen married John Wedgewood and Elizabeth (Bessy) Allen married Josiah Wedgewood jr. A third sister, Jessie Allen, married the French economist Jean Charles Simonde de Sismondi Catherine and James Mackintosh married a year after the first Mrs Mackintosh (Catherine, neé Stuart) died in April 1797. They left for India in 1804, returning in 1811/12. Mackintosh was knighted in December 1803.
